observations.h1: A Martin kernel with isolated Harnack contact in an annulus
observations.originalAbstract: For the annulus 1 < |z| < e, we exhibit a normalized minimal Martin kernel that is strictly below the envelope of normalized positive harmonic functions at every point of a punctured neighborhood of the base point. Four explicit positive harmonic competitors give a uniform first-order gap in every direction. The result disproves the extension to multiply connected domains of the equality-along-a-Green-line property in Hayman and Lingham's Problem 7.42, attributed to Arsove and Johnson. We give direct constructions of the Green and Martin kernels and a proof of minimality. The broader negative conclusion also has a simpler punctured-disc derivation from classical results; our theorem gives a smooth-annulus construction. OpenAI tools were used extensively in developing and independently checking the argument. This note has not undergone human peer review or formal proof-assistant verification.
